name: all-profile
title_zh: 五个平台的个人简介一次对齐改写
tagline_zh: LinkedIn 一句话、YouTube 频道简介、IG 首行、TikTok 签名、X 简介，五处口径各说各话。
tagline_en: Your LinkedIn headline, YouTube description, IG bio, TikTok and X bios all say different things. It audits first.
desc_en: Audit, write, and update social profiles across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and X. Covers bios, headlines, About sections, YouTube channel descriptions, links, evidence-backed positioning, and verification of approved live edits. Use for one profile or cross-platform consistency, not post or video descriptions, content calendars, account-ban investigations, or repository descriptions.
why_zh: 先审后写：定位句必须挂上可验证的经历，写不出证据的形容词会被它删掉，而不是替你编一个。
why_en: Audit before writing: every positioning line must hang on verifiable experience. Adjectives you can't back up get cut, not.
limit_zh: 只管个人档案页：bio、headline、About、频道简介、外链。帖子文案、视频描述、内容日历、封号申诉。
limit_en: Profile pages only: bios, headlines, About sections, channel descriptions, links. No post copy, video descriptions, content calendars, ban appeals.
title_en: Rewrite and align your bios across five platforms
